sources.source: script Minimal version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Int = 1; on start { x = x + 1; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; import math; entity E { state out: Rat = 0; on update { out = twice(3); } }
module math version "1.0.0"; export fn twice(x: Rat) -> Rat = x * 2;
script Root version "1.0.0"; fn twice(x: Rat) -> Rat = x + x; entity E { state out: Rat = 0; on update { out = twice(time.delta()); } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior A { on update { log "A"; } } behavior B { on update { log "B"; } } entity E { use A; use B; on update { log "E"; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; entity E { state sum: Int = 0; on start { for i in 0 .. 4 { sum = sum + i; } } }

script Root version "1.0.0"; capability probe.read() -> Bool observation; entity E { state hits: Int = 0; on update { if false and probe.read() { hits = hits + 1; } if true or probe.read() { hits = hits + 1; } } }

script Root version "1.0.0"; capability sensor.read() -> Int observation; capability sink.write(Int) -> Unit effect; entity E { state x: Int = 0; on update { x = sensor.read(); call sink.write(x); } }

script Root version "1.0.0"; behavior Producer { on start { emit pulse(1); } } behavior Consumer { state seen: Rat = 0; on pulse(value: Rat) { seen = value; } } entity E { use Producer; use Consumer; on update { return; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } enum K { A; B; } entity E { state x: Int = 1; on start { x = x + 1; } }
script Root version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } fn get(r: R) -> Int = r.x; entity E { state x: Int = get(R(x = 7)); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } entity E { state r: R = R(x = 1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum K { A; } entity E { state k: K = K::A; on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Option<Int> = Some(1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; entity E { state x: Result<Int, Text> = Ok(1); on start { return; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } entity E { on update { let r = R(x = 1); log "x"; } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; enum K { A; B; } entity E { state x: Int = 0; on update { let k = K::A; match k { K::A => { x = 1; } K::B => { x = 2; } } } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } capability sink.write(R) -> Unit effect; entity E { on update { call sink.write(R(x = 1)); } }
script Bad version "1.0.0"; record R { x: Int; } fn make() -> Int = R(x = 1).x; entity E { state out: Int = 0; on update { out = make(); } }
